criteria.text: Config-change diagnoses with evidence quotes absent from attached evidence emit no actionable proposal.
Config-change diagnoses without evidence quotes emit no actionable proposal.
The install boundary rejects arbitrary-origin, plain-HTTP, unpinned skill URLs even when the content hash matches.
Manager routing text never names an engine builtin denied by projected task permissions.
Manager routing text never names the current profile as its own delegate.
Manager routing text never renders an empty delegate name.
Installed-skill overlap compares candidate identity without contaminating it with the capability-gap title.
Installed-skill overlap checks title plus the already-downloaded candidate body.
Non-retry workflow signals do not produce retry-loop-specific recipe boilerplate.
Evidence quotes shorter than the grounding minimum cannot authorize an actionable diagnosis.
Grounding accepts honest evidence quotes after whitespace normalization.
Grounding accepts an honest evidence quote containing one ellipsis for omitted words.
Infrastructure signatures are excluded from deterministic proposal generation.
Excluded infrastructure signals remain operator-visible through an explicit log line.
Unverified-claim evidence cannot authorize a full skill-body replacement regardless of prose wording.
